verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear order (logo, headline, body, tags, CTA) with a large CTA. Flaws: the circle crowds the GROVE logo, the body copy sits very close to the pills, the right-aligned pills and CTA are misaligned with the left-aligned text, and the bottom margin is tight. B shrinks the CTA to a tiny pill the same size as the tags, so it is buried among four equal chips. B also puts the CTA above the body copy, which breaks reading order, leaves a large dead gap, and sets the body text far from the headline. B's headline and image are good, but the hierarchy failure is worse.
